id: # One row per document in the library (/documents/). The site shows a row only when publish = yes AND it has a link (url, or a drive_path that scripts/drive_ids.py turns into a link). Full guide: scripts/README-documents.md.

# id = short unique name (never change it). collection = Current | Archive (documents from the previous panel's first year on are always Current). category = the shelf: Minutes, Agendas, Motions, Reports, Delegate, Finances, Guidelines, Conference, GSO, Workbooks, Service, Forms, Calendar, Contributions, Newsletters, District, Flyers, PRAASA, Archives, Misc. title_en / title_es = titles (Spanish one optional). date = 2026-10-11 or 2026-10 (year alone goes in year). language = English | Spanish | Bilingual. format = PDF | Word | Excel | PowerPoint.

# meeting_type = ASC | ASA | Board (Area minutes and agendas — with the exact date they are matched to /service/area-meetings/). district = d01-03, d05 … committee = committee slug. publish = yes | review (held for an anonymity check — never shown) | no (never shown). anonymity_flag = why it is held. drive_path = path in the Area Drive starting with docs/. url = Drive link. ANONYMITY: run python scripts/scan-documents.py --file <your.pdf> before adding a file.
